entities.summary: Joseph Eric D'Arcy was the ninth Archbishop of the Catholic Archdiocese of Hobart, Tasmania, Australia, from 1988 to 1999. Immediately prior to his appointment to Hobart, D'Arcy served as the sixth Bishop of the Diocese of Sale from 1981 to 1988.
